deepseek_v4_pro/001: The strategy is an iterative-deepening alpha-beta search with time management. It orders moves by captures first, then safe moves, and uses a heuristic that scores completed boxes, nearly completed boxes, and safe move availability.
deepseek_v4_pro/002: The strategy for this policy is a minimax-based approach with alpha-beta pruning. It evaluates the board by considering box completion opportunities, chain formations, and potential sacrifices. The policy prioritizes moves that complete boxes, avoids giving away boxes to the opponent, and uses a heuristic to evaluate long chains that can be captured in sequence. Due to the 1-second time limit, the search depth is limited and iterative deepening is used to maximize the depth within the time constraint.
deepseek_v4_pro/003:
The strategy for this policy is to use a minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, focusing on avoiding giving away boxes while looking for opportunities to capture chains. The algorithm will:

1. First check if there are any immediate box-capturing moves available
2. If no captures are available, use a depth-limited minimax search to evaluate moves
3. The evaluation function will penalize moves that create three-sided boxes (which give the opponent a capture opportunity)
4. It will also consider chain length and try to force the opponent into unfavorable positions
5. Use iterative deepening to make the best use of the 1-second time limit
deepseek_v4_pro/004: The strategy for this policy is to use a minimax search with alpha-beta pruning and a state evaluation heuristic that prioritizes capturing chains and avoiding giving the opponent opportunities to capture. Since the game is small enough (4×4 grid), we can look several moves ahead, especially in the endgame. The evaluation function considers: maximizing our captures, minimizing opponent captures, and avoiding creating vulnerable three-sided boxes (which hand points to the opponent). We also incorporate a simple chain detection heuristic to make capturing long chains more efficient.
deepseek_v4_pro/005: The strategy for this policy is to use iterative deepening alpha-beta search with Zobrist hashing transposition tables and a heuristic move ordering. Moves that capture boxes are prioritized first, followed by safe moves that do not give the opponent a capture opportunity, and finally unsafe moves. The evaluation function at leaf nodes is simply the difference in captured boxes, and the search runs until a 0.9-second time limit is reached.
